notes:
Derin is a focus timer: each completed focus session lights a star, and stars complete constellations.

- No account is needed. Every feature works without signing in. Sign in with Apple / Google is optional and only backs up progress; accounts can be deleted in Settings > Account > Delete account.
- Screen Time (FamilyControls): on the Focus setup screen the user can choose to block distracting apps (or all apps) during a session. Screen Time authorization is requested only when the user picks a blocking option (or taps the button in Settings). The selection never leaves the device.
- Spotify is optional: suggested playlists open in the Spotify app; connecting an account is not required.
- Ambient sounds are from Freesound under CC0 / CC BY licences; attribution is in Settings.
- No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases in this version.
